items.html: And also, it is known that now, in their ascent in the secret of Ibur, it is the phase of their ascent in the secret of MAN, and they cause a coupling in AVI, and bring down male and female drops. And through these drops these Nekudot become bound together, and then the phase of their vessels is clarified, and they ascend upward in the secret of Ibur, and are corrected there.
